summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports key metrics: GTV of RMB711.7 billion (down 15.6% YoY), net revenues of RMB18.9 billion (down 19.0% YoY), and net income of RMB1,255 million (up 46.7% YoY). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is described. This is a routine quarterly earnings release by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 2.02 disclosure of operating results. No action, terms, or structural changes warrant classification as a special situation.
